task.description:
WF-03 Step 2b — Validate fix design at src/design/fix-ISS-QRY-bugs-20260818.md.

Verify:
1. The design covers all 4 issue root causes confirmed by ISSUE-FIXER
2. The design contains NO Zig implementation code (only interfaces, types, SQL shapes, data-flow)
3. Issue 1 (#823): typed-column merge from entity_definitions is specified with enough precision for BACKEND-DEV to implement
4. Issue 1 (#823): tenant isolation via search_path is specified; tenant_id parameter removed from entity_filterable_keys query (per SPT-03)
5. Issue 2 (#824): rejected_filter_field out-parameter or equivalent mechanism specified; error body format specified
6. Issue 3 (#825): cursor format is unambiguous; encode and decode are deterministic; empty sort case handled
7. Issue 4 (#826): test column name fix is specified
8. No acceptance criteria from QRY-01..04 are left uncovered by the fix

Return PASS if all checks pass. Return FAIL with specific gaps if not.

result.summary: Fix design for #823/#824/#825/#826 is technically correct on all 8 content checks but fails the mandatory lint gate with 2 MAJOR structural defects. Route back to CODE-DESIGNER for rework.

issues.detail: Missing required section for 'purpose'. The artefact opens with a list of per-issue sections but omits a top-level 'Module purpose' paragraph (or equivalent heading matching 'module purpose' | 'purpose') that states the overall intent of the fix in one clear paragraph. Required by Type E completeness rules.

Missing required section for 'errors'. Each issue section names its error cases inline but the artefact lacks a unified 'Error taxonomy' section (heading matching 'error taxonomy' | 'errors' | 'error cases'). The parent design (qry-01-04-entity-query.md) has one; the fix artefact must include one covering the new/changed error paths introduced or affected by the four fixes.

content_check_results.check_1_all_root_causes_covered: PASS — #823 allowlist merge, #824 out-param, #825 cursor b64url, #826 column rename all addressed with confirmed root causes.
content_check_results.check_2_no_zig_implementation_code: PASS — Only function signatures and algorithm pseudo-code blocks present; no function bodies (no { ... } with statement sequences). No SQL DDL.
content_check_results.check_3_typed_column_merge_precision: PASS — Query 2 SQL shape with params, JSONB field extraction (queried=true, name/storage_type), storage_type enum mapping with default, is_sortable=true assignment, and merge priority rule are all specified.
content_check_results.check_4_search_path_tenant_isolation: PASS — SPT-03 pattern explicitly named; confirmed against actual migration 1168_qry_filterable_keys.sql (scope: tenant_only, no tenant_id column); Query 1 SQL uses only $1=entity_key; tenant_id used in Query 2 against entity_definitions with $1::uuid predicate.
content_check_results.check_5_rejected_filter_field_outparam: PASS — *?[]const u8 out-parameter specified; null init; dupe-on-mismatch with OOM fallback (omit field key); handler declare/defer-free pattern; both JSON body shapes specified.
content_check_results.check_6_cursor_format_unambiguous: PASS — New format QE:<ts>:<b64url_fp>:<vals> eliminates colon ambiguity; encode and decode algorithms are deterministic; no-sort default case (record_id:asc → cmVjb3JkX2lkOmFzYw) explicitly demonstrated; wire-format breaking change documented with correct client behaviour.
content_check_results.check_7_test_column_fix: PASS — Two replacements at lines 560 and 985 of query_qry01_04_test.zig; created_at → timestamp on audit_entries ORDER BY.
content_check_results.check_8_acceptance_criteria_coverage: PASS — QRY-01 ACs (injection prevention, parameterization, audit, read-only) unchanged. QRY-02 AC requiring field name in filter_field_not_allowlisted error fixed by #824. QRY-02 AC requiring typed-column merge fixed by #823. QRY-03 cursor ACs restored by #825. QRY-04 empty-envelope path untouched.

result.next_action: Route back to CODE-DESIGNER (rework cycle 1/2). Add: (1) a top-level 'Module purpose' section; (2) a unified 'Error taxonomy' section covering the new/changed error paths for all four fixes. All content checks pass — rework is structural only.
